summary.text: Darrell Jackson is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Darrell Jackson was also the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 79 in the 2014 general election, according to Ballotpedia, which says he was unopposed in that year's Democratic primary.

Ballotpedia quotes his 2014 campaign website as describing him as a former Deputy Sheriff, and as listing public safety, the economy, school funding and support for the middle class as campaign themes.

sources.title: Ohio House of Representatives elections, 2026 - Ballotpedia
